rows.actual: Submit 02:28:26Z showed "Check your email / We've sent a confirmation link to johan+portal@aiautomations.co.za / Click the link in the email to confirm your account, then you can log in. / Return to Login". Link opened in same browser landed on /portal/dashboard signed in (Welcome back, Johan, FREE MEMBER).
Wrong password: "Invalid login credentials". Right password: /portal/dashboard.

Forgot at 02:30:11Z: "Check your email / We sent a password reset link to ... The link expires in 60 minutes. If you don't see the email, check your spam folder." Reset link opened /portal/reset-password ("Set a new password", heading New Password); empty submit showed "Password must be at least 8 characters."; both fields set, Update Password went straight to /portal/dashboard?message=password-updated with no visible success text. Old password: "Invalid login credentials". New password: dashboard.

Tier Free Member; Programmes 0 (browse shop); My Programmes: "No programmes yet / Browse Suzanne's coaching programmes and start your transformation."; Upcoming Sessions, Transformation Community, Continue Learning (COMING SOON), Unlock more: "Upgrade to Silver or Gold membership..." with View Membership Plans. Console errors on own navigation: 0.

Before order: "No programmes yet / Start your transformation journey by enrolling in one of Suzanne's coaching programmes." + Browse Programmes (PASS). RE-CHECK after order #389 (free, voucher QA-SELFTEST-100), about 60 s after placing and after a reload: /portal/programmes still shows "No programmes yet", dashboard still shows Programmes "0 (browse shop)" and "No programmes yet". Getting Unstuck does NOT appear.

(gated). /resources/assessments open public page "COMING SOON ... These tools are not live yet for anyone, members included." Logged back in with new password (redirect-back worked).

/portal/videos shows "Video Library ... Videos coming soon / New sessions are uploaded after each cohort. Check back after your next live session." No watch control exists for a free member, so no player or /api/video request could be tested.

Phone was empty on a new account (signup does not collect it). Set +27 82 000 0001, Save Changes: "Profile updated successfully.", persisted after reload. Mismatching passwords: "New passwords do not match." Same new password again: "New password should be different from the old password." (422 from auth/v1/user), so the account password was not changed (it already is the new one).

Lists Starting Point (Guest Membership S0211 Free; Lifestyle S0212 R350/$20 annual), Akashic Track S0213-S0225 and Energy Clearing Track S0226-S0239 (28 UPGRADE NOW links, R525 to R2 625). First UPGRADE NOW goes to /shop/membership-s0212, which returns 404 Not Found.

findings.text: New user sees "Welcome back, Johan" on first dashboard.

Cookie banner intercepts click on Sign Out until dismissed. Re-seen in I-12: Reject could not be clicked on login and dashboard pages because page content intercepts pointer events; only a script-level click dismissed it.
/portal/reset-password renders inside the portal layout (sidebar with Dashboard/Sign Out) and shows no success message after update; user is dropped on the dashboard.
Portal tier names are inconsistent: resources and dashboard say Silver/Gold/Practitioner, upgrade page lists S0211-S0239 Guest/Lifestyle/Akashic/Energy Clearing tiers; no Silver or Gold exists.
Free resources in /portal/resources link to "#" (nothing opens).
Upgrade prices render as "R350$20 USD · annual" with no separator, and "R1 225" style.
Phone field on account is empty after signup; checkout contact step not prefilled from account (even when signed in).
Mobile: Videos is missing from the portal bottom tab bar; Brilliant Coach pill overlaps it; /portal/upgrade has 4px horizontal overflow.
I typed one extra throwaway string (Qa-Mismatch12345!) into the account confirm-password field to test the mismatch error; it was not used to log in.

Order #389 placed by the signed-in portal user (same email as the account) does not show in My Programmes or the dashboard after ~60 s plus reload. Either the Thinkific/portal enrolment sync lags, or the portal list is not reading this order. Controller to check order #389 in Medusa/Thinkific logs.
